caption:
The video captures a black-crowned night heron standing still in shallow, clear water above a bed of rounded pebbles, its dark mirror-image reflection pooled directly beneath it and a cluster of floating green aquatic plants at the left edge. The bird balances on one planted leg while the other foot remains raised above the surface, long toes splayed, and its black cap, red eye, gray folded wing, and white underparts stay visible throughout.

For the first portion of the clip the neck is held upright, with the bill pointing forward. As the segment continues, the neck bends forward and the head lowers into a more horizontal, hunched alignment, making the pale stripe along the back more prominent. The reflection below deforms in step with this tilt, its mirrored head moving forward as the real head dips. Meanwhile the framing shifts slightly, the bird and the underwater pebbles drifting toward the left.

Throughout the excerpt, the raised foot stays lifted, with no footfall occurring.
